Details about early decision plan
Only available for high school seniors applying for September admission; some programs do not have an Early
Decision option. If admitted, students must send in the required enrollment deposit by January 15 for Early
Decision. Applicants must withdraw applications to other colleges and universities. A statement of understanding,
acknowledging the binding nature of this program must be signed by student, counselor, and parent/guardian.
